intent_record.intent_summary: Fix potential use of uninitialized or NULL pd->uctx in error paths by using the passed uctx parameter instead.
intent_record.what: In the error handling labels (ucopy_err and dpp_map_err) of ocrdma_copy_pd_uresp, the first argument to ocrdma_del_mmap was changed from pd->uctx to uctx.
intent_record.how: At runtime, when an error occurs during PD-to-userspace copy, the cleanup code now uses the uctx parameter instead of pd->uctx. This avoids a potential NULL pointer dereference or using an uninitialized context pointer.

diff --git a/drivers/infiniband/hw/ocrdma/ocrdma_verbs.c b/drivers/infiniband/hw/ocrdma/ocrdma_verbs.c
new file mode 100644
index 000000000000..51fc9c7c0acf
--- /dev/null
+++
bic_trace_step.reason: In ocrdma_copy_pd_uresp(), the error paths at labels 'ucopy_err' and 'dpp_map_err' call ocrdma_del_mmap(pd->uctx, ...) before pd->uctx is set (line 'pd->uctx = uctx;' is only reached after successful completion). Since pd is kzalloc'd, pd->uctx is NULL at that point, causing a NULL pointer dereference. Specifically: at 'dpp_map_err', ocrdma_del_mmap(pd->uctx, db_page_addr, db_page_size) uses NULL; at 'ucopy_err', ocrdma_del_mmap(pd->uctx, dpp_page_addr, ...) also uses NULL. The code does not have any protection against this, so the vulnerability is present and not fixed.
